period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior period-end position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year, as published in the bank's own 'Un-audited Balance Sheet' and 'Un-audited Profit and Loss Account' for the period ended 30 September 2025. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'Mercantile Bank PLC.' / 'Mercantile Bank Limited' Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account with no 'and its Subsidiaries'/'Consolidated' qualifier; the same source PDF also contains an earlier CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account section headed 'Mercantile Bank PLC. and its Subsidiaries', which was correctly identified and NOT used, consistent with this bank's established SOLO reporting_basis). SOURCE PDF WAS A SCANNED IMAGE (0 lines extractable via pdftotext) -- recovered via OCR: rendered to PNG with pdftoppm at 250 DPI, then run through tesseract (--psm 6). Every balance-sheet and P&L subtotal was manually cross-checked against every internal arithmetic identity before being trusted -- balance-sheet identity (Total Assets = sum of 8 asset lines = Total Liabilities + Total Equity), Total Liabilities composition (Borrowings + Subordinated Bond + Perpetual Bond + Deposits + Other Liabilities), the full operating-income chain (Net Interest Income + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income = Total Operating Income), the expense/provision/tax/net-profit chain, the appropriation chain (Net Profit + Retained Surplus b/f = Appropriations + Retained Surplus c/f, cross-tied to the Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L line), Off-Balance-Sheet composition, and EPS (Net Profit / (Paid-up Capital / 10 par value)). This redundant-arithmetic approach caught and corrected specific OCR digit-substitution errors (documented per-period below) before any figure was accepted into this dataset; periods where a figure could not be confidently resolved this way were left as reported without forcing a correction. The 'Non-convertible Subordinated Bond' line showed no Sep-25 figure in the OCR read (only the Dec-24 comparative of 600,000,000 was legible), consistent with the bond having matured/been redeemed during the quarter (it had already been amortising: 1,800m in Mar-23, 1,200m through 2024, 600m at Dec-24). Total Liabilities (433,339,703,409) ties out exactly only when Subordinated Bond = 0 for Sep-25, confirming full redemption rather than a missing-data gap. Net interest income (143,723,588 for 9 months) continues the margin-compression trend seen in quarterly/2025_Q1.json (124,084,641 for Q1 alone) -- Q2+Q3 combined added only ~19.6m of further NII -- a genuine finding, not an OCR artifact: it ties out exactly as Interest income minus Interest expense and flows correctly through Total operating income and every downstream subtotal, including an exact retained-earnings tie to the Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L line.
